stemMd: Exchange of DNA between nonsister chromatids of homologous chromosomes normally occurs during which stage?
explanationMd: Homologues pair during prophase I, allowing crossing over between nonsister chromatids. This recombines alleles before homologues are separated in meiosis I.

distractorRationale.d: Recombination occurs before homologous chromosomes separate.
distractorRationale.e: Meiotic crossing over involves already replicated homologues.
distractorRationale.a: Homologous synapsis is not an ordinary feature of mitotic anaphase.
distractorRationale.b: Translation concerns RNA and protein synthesis.
